mentions.name: DiffUI
mentions.description: A diffusion-based UI design tool that generates unique user interface designs using diffusion models and then converts the generated images to code with LLMs. It is based on the hypothesis that LLMs produce visually consistent designs because they express design through code, while diffusion models trained on a wider set of visual data yield more unique outputs.
mentions.problem: LLMs trained to write consistent code also express design through code, so AI-generated UI designs end up visually consistent; diffusion models trained on broader visual data can produce more unique designs.
mentions.source_excerpt: A diffusion-based UI design tool I left Figma to build.
mentions.author: jjcm
